case: atomic, redacted, closure-only export; failed export leaves the previous deliverable intact

checks.name: closure only
checks.setup: a run folder with research/, crew/ logs, an unrelated doc and an accepted final that depends on 3 elements
checks.expect: the package holds exactly those elements plus manifest and notices; none of the other files or names appear

checks.name: unaccepted dependency
checks.setup: final depends on an artifact with accepted false
checks.expect: plan.ok false with not_accepted; nothing staged

checks.name: withdrawn rights
checks.setup: rights.jsonl withdrawn for a footage element
checks.expect: decision blocked with remediation; build refuses; nothing deleted

checks.name: non-redistributable font
checks.expect: decision external_requirement; not copied; listed in manifest.external_requirements

checks.name: path escape
checks.setup: element path '../secret.txt' and a symlink leaving the root

checks.name: secrets in a log line
checks.setup: manifest warning containing a fake sk- key and /Users/example/ path
checks.expect: exportSafe removes them; verifyPackage finds no leak; absolute paths never appear

checks.name: copy corruption
checks.expect: copy_mismatch; staging removed; failure record under delivery/failures/; exports/latest.json unchanged

checks.name: crash before publish
checks.expect: no <export-id> folder exists; previous export and latest.json intact; stale .staging-* swept by sweepTemps

checks.name: never overwrite
checks.expect: second call export_exists; the first folder is byte-identical

checks.name: originals preserved
checks.expect: source media is copied, never moved, and keeps its hash

checks.name: separate roles
checks.expect: masters/, previews/, captions/, audio/stems/, source/, licences/, interchange/ hold their own roles; baked previews are not placed in source/
